description: Send an existing draft by id. This DELIVERS real mail to the recipient, so confirm with the user before calling. This is the only draft tool that sends. Counts against the plan's monthly send quota at this point (the draft itself never did). The draft is marked sent and kept for reference. On failure returns { error, message } and leaves the draft unsent so it can be retried. If the mail goes out but the draft cannot be marked sent, returns success with warning 'not_recorded'. Never retry that one, since it would deliver a second copy.

id.description: Id of the draft to send

name: send_draft
